body:
Hannah (arch): Quick follow-up to RFC: propose a staggered deprecation policy for shims used by external SDKs. Goal: predictable windows + tooling to detect non-upgrading integrators.

Diego: TL;DR please: what are the windows?

Hannah (arch): Proposal: three lanes:
- Fast (30d): cosmetic wrappers, no semantics change.
- Standard (90d): envelope/headers, client header required; opt-out for new tenants at 45d.
- Slow (180d+): semantic changes (embeddings/dim/tokenization) + legal/compliance hold.

Rina: We must require an SDK-version header (X-RW-SDK-Version) on all requests to accurately detect which clients are impacted. Add SDK header enforcement rule for standard+ lanes.

Marcus: For enforcement: telemetry gate = both low global hit-rate AND low unique-tenant count. Suggested thresholds: <5 hits/day global AND <4 tenants OR mirrored-diff <0.05% on 1% sample. Exempt tenants with `compat:hold`.

Hannah (arch): Comms cadence: announce at 60/30/14/7/0 for standard/slow, and 14/7/1/0 for fast. Provide a sandbox CLI to run tenant compatibility checks.

ops-bot: feature-flag created: compat.deprec.staggered (staging).

Diego: Edge-case: on-prem customers w/out telemetry. Must provide a manual compatibility run and allow account teams to register a hold.

Rina: Add dashboard tile: SDK-version cohort over time + per-shim hit counts. Also wire alert if old-sdk ratio >2% during canary.

Marcus: Implementation tasks: (1) schema field in service-catalog for shim lane, (2) prune job respects `compat:hold` + support-ticket tags, (3) create reversible per-tenant revert flag for 7 days after prune.

Hannah (arch): Good. I'll write the RFC addendum with exact thresholds and playbook. Action items: @Rina dashboard + SDK-header enforcement, @Marcus prune job + revert flag, @Diego comms + CLI stub. Quick sync Wed to finalize.

Diego: ack

Rina: ack

Marcus: ack
